routes.label: Follow one student guaranteed by statement I

question:
Assume that, for a certain school, it is true that

\(\mathrm{I}:\) Some students are not honest.

\(\mathrm{II}:\) All fraternity members are honest.

A necessary conclusion is:
solution:
Statement I guarantees at least one student who is not honest. Consider that same student. If the student were a fraternity member, statement II would require the student to be honest, contradicting the way the student was chosen. Therefore that student is not a fraternity member.

Hence some students are not fraternity members, choice C.
